description: Full replacement of track state. `releases` is an array of release objects — versionCodes, status (draft|inProgress|halted|completed), userFraction (0-1 for staged rollout), inAppUpdatePriority (0-5), countryTargeting, and releaseNotes.

editId.description: Edit id returned by `edits_insert` — required for all edits.* writes

packageName.description: Android application package name, e.g. com.example.app

track.description: Track name: internal, alpha, beta, production — or a custom closed-testing track id

name: tracks_update
